findings.title: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) slightly exceeds 2.5s
findings.description: LCP of 2800ms is in the 'needs improvement' range. The main content loads slowly on mobile networks.
findings.recommendation: Preload the LCP image, optimize the hero section, and implement dynamic import for below-the-fold content.

findings.title: Total Blocking Time (TBT) needs improvement
findings.description: TBT of 320ms exceeds the 200ms target. Some JavaScript tasks block interactivity during load.
findings.recommendation: Break up long tasks in the analytics and onboarding scripts. Consider web workers for heavy computation.

findings.title: Serve images in next-gen formats
findings.description: 8 product screenshots are served as PNG where WebP would reduce size by 35-45%.
findings.recommendation: Convert product screenshots to WebP with JPEG fallback for older browsers.

findings.title: Some links have the same accessible name as their destination
findings.description: 5 links use the URL as their accessible name instead of descriptive text, confusing screen reader users.
findings.recommendation: Use descriptive link text that indicates the destination or purpose.

findings.title: ARIA attributes do not match their roles
findings.description: 2 dropdown menus use aria-expanded incorrectly, providing wrong state information to assistive technologies.
findings.recommendation: Ensure ARIA attributes are valid for the element's role and update dynamically with JavaScript.

findings.title: Image elements do not have [alt] attributes
findings.description: 4 decorative images lack alt attributes. While decorative images should have alt='', they still need the attribute present.
findings.recommendation: Add alt='' to decorative images and descriptive alt text to informational images.

findings.title: Links are not crawlable
findings.description: 3 links use JavaScript onclick handlers instead of proper href attributes, preventing search engine crawling.
findings.recommendation: Use proper <a href='...'> elements for navigation links. JavaScript handlers should enhance, not replace, HTML links.

findings.title: Uses a library with known security vulnerabilities
findings.description: Lodash 4.17.20 has a known prototype pollution vulnerability (CVE-2021-23337).
findings.recommendation: Update lodash to version 4.17.21 or later.

findings.title: Missing Permissions-Policy header
findings.description: No Permissions-Policy header is set, allowing all browser features by default.
findings.recommendation: Set a Permissions-Policy header to restrict unused browser features like camera, microphone, and geolocation.

opportunities.title: Preconnect to required origins
opportunities.description: 3 third-party origins could be preconnected to save 200-400ms on initial connection time.

opportunities.title: Reduce unused CSS
opportunities.description: 2 stylesheets contain 45KB of unused selectors that could be removed.

opportunities.title: Use video formats for animated content
opportunities.description: 2 animated GIFs could be converted to WebM or MP4 video for 60-80% size reduction.
